args.title: Replace localhost in password reset email link with PUBLIC_URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses `BASE_URL`, which defaults to `http://localhost:3000` when `PUBLIC_URL` is not set. This causes the reset link to point to localhost, breaking external access. The fix is to ensure `BASE_URL` always uses the configured `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable, falling back to localhost only in development or when explicitly set.
